{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper handling of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for non-numeric revenue values
revenue_sample = sales_df['revenue'].sample(10)
print(revenue_sample)

# Clean revenue: remove non-numeric characters and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('[^0-9.]', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Confirm it worked
print('\nSample of cleaned revenue:', sales_df['revenue_clean'].sample(5).values)"}
